column6: If we shorten the founder email to sixty words for smb-mfg owners, reply rate moves from 3.4 % to 6 % because shorter emails got more replies in the vendor data
If we gate the ROI calculator behind a work email for smb-mfg finance heads, MQL rate moves from 1.2 % to 2 % because gated tools qualified intent in past campaigns
If we swap the hero image for a plant-floor photo for smb-mfg plant managers, landing CVR moves from 3.8 % to 5 % because stock photos depressed engagement in heatmaps
If we run lead ads with the stockout checklist for smb-mfg owners, lead rate moves from 2.6 % to 4 % because the checklist drew requests at the trade booth
